verdict.rationale: Codex documents cloud-based delegation of longer tasks: run tasks in isolated cloud environments, in parallel, without tying up the local machine, kicked off from web/GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack, with configurable per-repo environments, and returning a summary/diff/PR when ready. This directly matches the story of delegating a long-running task to an isolated cloud environment. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the cloud environment specifically (community evidence is about CLI/app UX and models generally, not the cloud task delegation feature) and more detail on isolation/security guarantees of the cloud sandbox.
